description: Guardrails for MERIDIAN CORE. One hosted install; the automation is contained to its member-servicing routes and may never reach the fault-injection console it is tested with.

irreversible.description: Posts a funds transfer. Money moves between shares and staff cannot reverse it from this screen — the application says so on the confirmation page.
Applies a hold to a share. Restricted to supervisors, freezes the member's funds, and is labelled IRREVERSIBLE ACTION by the application itself.
Opens a new share on the member's record and posts the initial deposit. Creates a record that cannot be un-created.
Backstop for any commit control this policy has not been taught by name. Deliberately broad: an unrecognised commit button should stop and ask, not proceed.

mutating.description: Writes new contact details onto the member record. Changes real data, but the previous values can be typed back.
Types into a field. Changes client state only until submitted.
Chooses a dropdown value. Changes client state only until submitted.
